_notes.n-ungranted-archive: We should look more at exactly how Notes should store it's material. Is a folder the best solution?   What about a bundle or package?
_notes.p-reocr-refusals: Refuse encrypted and signed, but allow everything else.
_notes.p-intel-tools: How hard would it be to ship a universal version? I thought there were many parts of the app that couldn't be universal. If it's just this part then it seems worth including if it makes Intel possible.
_notes.p-pair-size:
Image-and-text pairs will be with handwritten text generally, and these outputs generally need to be at a higher quality as the handwriting is difficult to read. This doesn't however mean that they should be at original quality. 

Separately, we need to queue work to figure out how we want to provide for keeping preservation copies when lossy compression is used.
_notes.p-flag-unmeasured: Why would we nnot be able to use the threshold for pages the app turned? Imported pages? Also, haven't we done these measurements for pages read in regions? What are batch pages — pages run by a batched LLM? This seems very confused.
_notes.p-preocr-labels: What do you mean "its outputs are its inputs"? Need more context for this generally.
_notes.p-openrouter-rotation: Do we do page rotation with other routes to models? If so it's hard to see why we couldn't do it over OpenRouter, when desired.
_notes.p-kind-sample: Why wouldn't we render PDF pages for this work? Why would we only look at photographs?
_notes.p-settings-ui-scope: "Scope choices made while building settings" seems like a terrible reason for doing something. We should do this the correct way.
_notes.r-crash-undo: How unsafe would it be to offer the earlier undo history? It's certainly desirable. It's hard for me to judge the safety here.
_notes.r-word-pairing: How costly? Fixing it is certainly desirable.
_notes.r-folder-date-clear: Do this properly: update dates that were written due to the folder date and that have not otherwise been changed or confirmed by the user or due to the file itself.
_notes.r-set-selection: We shouldn't have arbitrary limits like this unless fixing them is costly.
_notes.r-menu-limits:
What are "nested folders"? I don't think these are a real thing in an archive. Or are we talking about folders in the app's filesystem? 

We shouldn't have an arbitrary limit like 100. At a certain size we may need to use something other than a menu.
_notes.n-paste-race: I need more context for this one. What is "the same second"? Literally a single second in time? What's the cost of fixing this?
_notes.n-assets-boundary: What do we mean "written in by hand"? Images copied into a note should I think be copied into the asset folder or similar.
